spans.s:
m. (-ण्डः)
The upper arm, from the elbow to the shoulder.
f. (-ण्डी)
An outer wall or rampart.
E.
प्र principal, गण्ड part.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Separate, apart.
2 Gone with difficulty.
E.
प्र, and गत gone.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु)
Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart.
E.
प्रगत separated, and जानु the knee.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart.
E.
प्र away, गत gone, जानु the knee, कन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Speaking, beginning to speak.
E.
प्र before गद to speak, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Progress, advance.
2 Difficult progress.
3 Going afar or apart.
4 Disputing, words.
E.
प्र, and गम to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-ल्भः-ल्भा-ल्भं)
1 Bold, confident.
2 Prompt, ready.
3 Resolute, energetic.
4 Illustrious, eminent.
5 Strong, able.
6 Shameless, impudent, audacious.
m. (-ल्भः)
The fire used for oblations at the birth of a child.
f. (-ल्भा)
A woman who courts her husband's caresses, a bold or confident woman.
E.
प्र much, गल्भ to be proud, aff. अच्.

f. (-ता)
1 Energy, resolution.
2 Confidence, boldness.
3 Audacity, arrogance.
4 Power, eminence, consequence.
5 Perverseness, wilfulness.
E.
तल् aff. of the abstract, added to the last; also with त्व, प्रगल्भत्वं.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Much, excessive.
2 Hard, difficult.
3 Hard, firm.
n. (-ढं)
Pain, privation, penance.
n. adv. (-ढं)
1 Much, exceedingly.
2 Tightly, firmly.
E.
प्र before गाढ much, exceeding.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
A capital singer.
E.
प्र excellent, and गातृ who sings.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sung, vocal.
E.
प्र, and गीत sung.

Straight.
2

Honest, upright, straight in morals.
E.
प्र excellent, and गुण quality.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
1 More, exceeding.
2 Excellent.
E.
प्र before गुण a quality or quantity, and क्यप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Collected, strung together.
2 Accepted, admitted.
E.
प्र, and गृहीत taken.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be taken, accepted, admitted, &c.
mn. (-ह्यः-ह्यं)
The class of letters or syllables not subject to the rules of euphony, as the final ई or उ of the dual number, &c. as हरी एतौ, विष्णू इमौ, &c.

ind.
Dawn, morning.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Relating, or belonging to the morning.
E.
प्रगे morning, and द्यु aff., तन् inserted.

n. (-णं)
Protection, preservation, salvation.
E.
प्र especially, गोपन preserving.

m. (-हः)
1 Taking, seizing.
2 Confinement, restriction, restraint, captivity.
3 A prisoner, a captive, either man or beast in confinement.
4 A rein, a rope or halter for horses, and cattle.
5 The string suspending a balance.
6 Favour, kindness.
7 An arm.
8 A ray of light.
9 A sort of Cassia, (C. fistula.)
E.
प्र before ग्रह to take or seize, aff. अप्; otherwise with घञ्, aff. प्रग्राह.

Seizing.
2

Taking, taking up, bearing, carrying.
3 The string of a balance.
4 A rein, &c.
E.
प्र before ग्रह to take, घञ् aff.; see प्रग्रह.

n. (-णं)
1 Taking, seizing.
2 Assuming.
E.
प्र before ग्रह to take, ल्युट् aff.

mn. (-वः-वं)
1 A window, a lattice, a balcony.
2 A summer house, a pleasure house.
3 A building on the top of a palace, a painted turret.
4 A wooden balustrade or fence on the edge of a building.
5 A stable.
6 The top of a tree.
E.
प्र excessive or excellent, and ग्रीवा a neck; the neck as it were of a house.

mfn. (-ग्लः-ग्ला-ग्लं)
Wearied, fatigued, exhausted.
E.
प्र before ग्लै to be weary, क aff.

m. (-वः)
Antecedent privation, the non-existence of any thing which may yet be. In law, the non-possession of property that may be possessed.
E.
प्राक् prior, अ negative, and भाव being.

n. (-ल्भ्यं)
1 Confidence, boldness, determination.
2 Arrogance, effrontery.
3 Importance, rank.
E.
प्रगल्भ confident, यञ् aff.

f. (-ची)
The north-east.
E.
प्राक् the east, and उदीची the north.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going before, a precursor.
E.
प्राच, and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-षः)
A country, Kāmarūpa, part of Asam.
E.
प्राक् formerly, ज्योतिष light; being the scene of BRAHMĀ'S penance.

m. (-रः)
The top or peak of a mountain.
E.
प्राक् first, भार burthen; also read प्राग्भाव.

m. (-वः)
1 Prior existence.
2 Superiority, excellence.
3 The top of a mountain.
E.
प्राक्, and भाव being or nature.

ind.
From a prior state of being.
E.
प्राग्भाव, and तसि aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Chief, principal.
E.
प्र and अग्र first, हर who surpasses.

n. (-टं)
Thin curds.
E.
प्र before अग्र the top, and अट what goes.

mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं)
Chief, principal.
E.
प्र prefixed to अग्र्य chief.

m. (-शः)
1 The room opposite to that which contains the materials for an oblation, and in which the family and friends of the sacrificer assemble.
2 A former dynasty or race.
E.
प्राक् before, and वंश a race, &c.
